entities.name: tree canopy replacement
entities.description: Discussion and planning related to replacing and restoring the city’s tree canopy to address environmental concerns, including impacts of climate change and urban forestry management.

entities.name: temperature change
entities.description: The phenomenon of rising temperatures in South Florida, its impact on local ecosystems, particularly trees, and related discussions on climate adaptation strategies.

entities.name: tree succession
entities.description: The process of replacing mature trees with new growth, considering potential impacts of climate change and temperature variations on tree species and urban green spaces.
